The rabbit has dense, textured fur in shades of brown, grey, and black (agouti pattern). Its ears are upright, one slightly angled back. The eyes are dark and reflective. The nose and mouth area are visible but partially obscured by shadow and fur texture. The body is compact and rounded. The hind legs are tucked beneath the body, not fully extended. The tail is not clearly visible from this angle. The lighting is somewhat dim, creating soft shadows.
